name: furrbox
description: FurrBox private Windows 11 inspired desktop environment with real-time file sync.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,electron -c cyan,green,magenta "npm --workspace backend run dev" "npm --workspace frontend run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 http://localhost:4000/health && electron ./electron/main.js"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c cyan,green "npm --workspace backend run dev" "npm --workspace frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,electron -c cyan,green,magenta "npm --workspace backend run start" "npm --workspace frontend run start" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 http://localhost:4000/health && electron ./electron/main.js"
scripts.build: npm --workspace frontend run build && npm --workspace backend run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace frontend run lint && npm --workspace backend run lint
